description_en: Queries task executions using multiple filters
description_zh: 查询任务执行，支持多种过滤方式
kebab_example: aliyun oos list-task-executions --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --execution-id exec-xxx --status Running --start-date-before 2019-05-16T10:26:14Z --start-date-after 2019-05-16T10:26:14Z --end-date-before 2019-05-16T10:26:14Z --end-date-after 2019-05-16T10:26:14Z --task-execution-id task-exec-xxx --task-name describeInstance --task-action ACS::Sleep --parent-task-execution-id task-exec-xxx --include-child-task-execution false --max-results 50 --next-token MTRBMDc0NjAtRUJFNy00N0NBLTk3NTctMTJDQzQ3NjFENDdB --sort-field StartDate --sort-order Ascending --account-id 123456789 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListTaskExecutions

parameters.help_en: The execution status to filter by. Valid values: `Running`, `Started`, `Success`, `Failed`, `Waiting`, `Cancelled`, `Pending`, and `Skipped`
parameters.help_zh: 执行状态，取值范围：Running, Started, Success, Failed, Waiting, Cancelled, Pending, Skipped
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: Filters for executions that started on or before the specified time. The time must be in ISO 8601 format
parameters.help_zh: 开始时间小于等于指定时间的执行
parameters.name: start_date_before

parameters.help_en: Filters for executions that started on or after the specified time. The time must be in ISO 8601 format
parameters.help_zh: 开始时间大于等于指定时间的执行
parameters.name: start_date_after

parameters.help_en: Filters for executions that ended on or before the specified time. The time must be in ISO 8601 format
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间小于等于指定时间的执行
parameters.name: end_date_before

parameters.help_en: Filters for executions that ended on or after the specified time. The time must be in ISO 8601 format
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间大于等于指定时间的执行
parameters.name: end_date_after

parameters.help_en: The parent task execution ID. This parameter is used in loop scenarios to specify the execution of the parent task
parameters.help_zh: 父任务执行ID。Loop情况会用到，一般是Loop的Parent的TaskExecutionId
parameters.name: parent_task_execution_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to include child task executions that are generated by a loop. Default: `false`
parameters.help_zh: 标记是否展示Loop产生的子Task。默认为False
parameters.name: include_child_task_execution

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of items to return per page. Valid range: 20 to 100. Default: 50
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小。取值范围：20-100。默认为50
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The token to request the next page of results. You can get this value from the `NextToken` parameter of the previous response
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The sort field for the results. Valid values:

StartDate (Default): Sorts the results by start date.

EndDate: Sorts the results by end date.

Status: Sorts the results by status
parameters.help_zh:
排序字段。取值范围：
StartDate（默认值）：创建时间
EndDate：结束时间
Status：状态
parameters.name: sort_field

parameters.help_en:
The sort order for the results. Valid values:

Ascending: Sorts results in ascending order.

Descending (Default): Sorts results in descending order
parameters.help_zh:
排序方向。取值范围：
Ascending：升序
Descending（默认值）：降序
parameters.name: sort_order
